text:
Maya: quick question — should the operator inbox for automatic fallback show every fallback event or a compact sampled view? thinking about noise vs. forensic needs
Sam: compact by default, with an expand-to-playback action. we don't want ops drowning in low-value events during spikes.
Owen: +1 compact. but need guaranteed capture for policy-change windows and canaries. also retention rules for audits (90d?)
Jess: UI idea: top-level cards for "high-severity" (user-facing errors, >5xx threshold) and a collapsible list for "sampled" low-severity ones. filters by route/model/tenant.
Kai: one more question: do we expose a full "why_did_you_fallback" text blob in the inbox? that can be large and leak sensitive request info. maybe surface a short reason + link to secure trace.
Sam: agree — surface a summary tag (e.g., "latency_tail", "5xx_spike", "quota_exceeded") and a playback link that follows ACLs. payload example:
```json
{
  "decision_id": "dec-20260322-01",
  "trigger": "5xx_spike",
  "route": "/api/v1/generate",
  "fallback_chain": ["model-a","model-b"],
  "summary": "5xx rate > 2% over 1m"
}
```
Owen: sampling heuristics proposal: capture 100% of severity>=high; sample 10% of medium; 0.5% of low. always capture 1 event/min per route to keep baseline telemetry. this keeps index size sensible and satisfies most audits.
Maya: what about quota/cost? storing full traces for every captured event hits storage/egress. can we store minimal metadata and stream raw full traces to cold storage on-demand?
Kai: yes, minimal metadata for index + object store pointer for full trace. also redact user content before storing full traces by default.
Jess: operator actions: quick mute a route, escalate to SRE, or copy decision to clipboard (for playbook). buttons need to be 1-click.
Sam: API changes — we'll add fields: "severity", "summary_tag", "trace_url", "decision_id". expose an /inbox query with filters and cursor pagination.
Owen: compliance ask: immutable audit export (CSV/NDJSON) for a given window. can we add an "export_for_audit" action that materializes all captured events in an S3 bucket with a signed URL?
Maya: yes, great. also add an operator override/escape-hatch button that records operator id + reason (mandatory).
Sam: small implementation question: should the console allow changing sampling rates per-tenant or is that infra-only?
Owen: per-tenant sampling needed for enterprise customers (they'll pay for more retention). but defaults set at org-level.
Kai: also note: decision replay needs deterministic traceability — include model version and input hashes in the metadata so replays are reproducible.
Jess: UX nit: show a time-series sparkline per route indicating fallback rate so operator can triage quickly.
Maya: ok next steps: Sam/Kai to draft API schema + sampling config, Owen to draft retention/export constraints, Jess to mock a compact inbox card and actions. deploy-bot: can we try a tiny prototype in the staging console this week?
DeployBot: deploy finished: feature-branch/inbox-proto -> staging (build 2026.03.22.9) :rocket:
Sam: I'll open a PR with schema + example payloads. tagging @Owen @Jess for feedback.
Owen: will add retention/compliance requirements to the PR description.
Maya: awesome. if everyone OK, we'll ship a limited roll-out (canary tenants) and monitor telemetry for noise and operator workload. :thumbsup:
